name: Bowl Packer
overview: A hard 5-pitch Joe Puryear first ascent on Goose Egg Mountain, documented only in Puryear's personal ascent log; no published approach, pitch-by-pitch, or gear beta could be found.

overview: A 700-foot, 7-pitch alpine rock climb on the south wall featuring loose chossy rock and the famous Jenga Traverse knife-edge crossing. The route deteriorates in rock quality mid-way but remains a classic Tieton alpine experience.

overview: A proud line with excellent position and climbing that is mostly well protected, but dirty by modern standards, with a complex approach. name: Reticent Slabs

approach: Follow the road into Clark's Fork Canyon and stop at a roadside pull-off on the right, near a fence gate. Head across toward the big slabs, bearing left. The route begins on top of a small rise, with a wash on its right, between two big trees; several bolts are visible from the ground.

descent: The usual way down is to rappel the route with two ropes (a single long rope runs out of length at some stations).
